product_metadata.title: MELLCOM Console Table Entryway Table 3 Tiered Sofa Table Classic Design with Drawer and Opening Shelves, Entryway Hall Table, Sofa Tables Narrow Easy Assembly Wood Grain
features: 【HIGH QUALITY MATERIAL】 Our console table is made of paulownia wood which light in weight, good in moisture resistance and wear resistance.The surface is painted with water-based paint, which is more environmentally friendly.

【CLASSIC STYLE DESIGN】With warm natural wood tones and retro features, this stylish console table suitable for a variety of styles of home decoration. The style is classic and durable can bring a delicate touch to your whole room.

【PRACTICAL & FUNCTIONAL】This 3-tier entry table can be used as a plant stand end table, coffee table, tea table, lamp table, foyer table and reading table to decorate your entryway, foyer, hallway, living room, bringing function to your living area without taking up too much space.

【LARGE CAPACITY】With the spacious tabletop(29”L x 10.7”W), this accent table is suitable for put something decorative like vase, photo frame, books. 2 middle opening storage shelves provides additional space for magazines or delicate small objects. Console table with smooth-gliding is good for concealed storage.

【EASY TO ASSEMBLE】With all needed instruction and hardware, Our sofa table is easy to finish the table up, helping you save much time and energy. Excellent customer service frees you from worrying about missing parts and damaged parts. Any question please contact us.
